name: Philip's Basket Toss
summary:
Stop wasting trees—and your precious paper—trying to relive your hoop dreams in real life! Now, with Philip's Basket Toss, you can experience the simple yet addictive thrill of tossing crumpled paper balls into a virtual wastebasket, right from the comfort of your own room.
